records.text: A commenter using the name Easy Hammer proposed the possibility that Twiggs was originally supposed to be the patsy and asked Robinson to take his place.
records.speaker: Easy Hammer (commenter; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: That's going to be so nutty and fun to play on the show. Stand by. Easy Hammer writes, what if Lance was supposed to be the patsy? He asked Tyler to take his spot for whatever reason.

verification.notes: The hypothesis is presented as Easy Hammer's audience comment, not Owens's own adoption. Searches did not independently recover the original comment. No evidence of a replacement agreement or assigned patsy role is supplied.

sources.title: Candace August 11 episode transcript
sources.relevance: Supports the on-air wording and attribution, not independent authentication of the underlying allegations.
